verses.text: We give thanks unto thee, O God; We give thanks, for thy name is near: Men tell of thy wondrous works.

segments.text: We give thanks unto thee, O God;
We give thanks, for thy name is near:
Men tell of thy wondrous works.

verses.text: When I shall find the set time, I will judge uprightly.

segments.text: When I shall find the set time,
I will judge uprightly.

verses.text: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have set up the pillars of it. [Selah

segments.text: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved:
I have set up the pillars of it. [Selah

verses.text: I said unto the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly; And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

segments.text: I said unto the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly;
And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

verses.text: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not with a stiff neck.

segments.text: Lift not up your horn on high;
Speak not with a stiff neck.

verses.text: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the south, cometh lifting up.

segments.text: For neither from the east, nor from the west,
Nor yet from the south,
cometh
lifting up.

verses.text: But God is the judge: He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.

segments.text: But God is the judge:
He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.

verses.text: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and the wine foameth; It is full of mixture, and he poureth out of the same: Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.

segments.text: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and the wine foameth;
It is full of mixture, and he poureth out of the same:
Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.

verses.text: But I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

segments.text: But I will declare for ever,
I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

verses.text: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

segments.text: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off;
But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.
